name: Milbert's Tortoiseshell
desc: Milbert's Tortoiseshell (Aglais milberti): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Aglais milberti, the fire-rim tortoiseshell or Milbert's tortoiseshell, is considered the only species of the proposed Aglais genus that occurs in North America.
